fixed_dimensions: every non-var axis is fixed by Muse Spark at TP8 / EP8: draft hidden 8192, intermediate 28672 (3584 a rank), kernel projection 2048 rows (2 sides x 2 taps x 512 groups of 16), 8-row blocks
notes: rows is the step's verify width: requests x 8 (DFlash2's 8 draft tokens). The monokernel spec routes a verify step to the kernels only at a compiled width; a smaller batch is assumed to run padded to the next width (spec.py checks only the live rows, out_cache_loc > 0, of a width: R = 3-4 -> 32 rows, 5-8 -> 64 rows) and a step of more than 8 requests to run SGLang's own path. Frequency: for each AgentX concurrency point C in {1, 2, 4, 8} (equal weight), R = the sum of C independent per-session in-flight counts, mapped to its padded width, renormalized over the steps the kernels serve. The kernel's work is independent of the context length (no context axis exists), so the 100x rule is unreachable: the production widths span 8x and every width is estimated >= 10 us (README.md).
